wins.text: Record AUM of $10.6 trillion at end of Q2 2024, with total net inflows of $82 billion ($150 billion excluding episodic client activity), representing 3% annualized organic base fee growth — highest second quarter in 3 years
Revenue of $4.8 billion up 8% YoY; operating income of $1.9 billion and EPS of $10.36 each up 12% YoY; operating margin of 44.1% expanded 160 bps YoY
ETF net inflows of $83 billion in Q2 and $150 billion in H1 2024 — best start to the year in iShares history, more than double H1 2023; BlackRock led the ETF industry in flows for H1 2024

Technology services ACV grew 10% YoY; tech services revenue up 10% YoY and 5% sequentially; 80% of new logo sales included multiple products; Preqin acquisition expected to increase current ACV dollars by ~15%
Aperio crossed $100 billion AUM milestone with 20%+ organic growth since acquisition ~3 years ago; bitcoin ETF gathered $18 billion in net inflows in its first 6 months, reaching nearly $20 billion

risks.text: Total net inflows impacted by an approximately $20 billion active fixed income redemption from a single large insurance client linked to M&A activity, masking underlying flow strength
Institutional index net outflows of $35 billion concentrated in low-fee index equities, as several large clients outside the U.S. rebalanced amid record equity market levels
Technology services ACV growth of 10% is at the low end of the long-term low-to-mid-teens target range, with timing of large contract conversions uncertain
GIP acquisition still pending regulatory approval with expected Q3 2024 close; Preqin expected to close before year-end — integration execution risk across two simultaneous large acquisitions
Nearly $9 trillion sitting in money market funds at 5% yields, keeping many investors overweight cash and delaying re-risking flows into long-term asset classes that would benefit BlackRock

guidance_items.detail: 5% organic base fee growth target reaffirmed over the long term; management expressed strong conviction of reaching it in H2 2024 and beyond
ACV growth target of low-to-mid-teens reaffirmed over the long term; Preqin expected to accelerate ACV within that target range after close
Head count expected to be broadly flat in 2024 (excluding GIP/Preqin impact); core G&A expense expected to increase low-to-mid-single-digit percentage in 2024
Share repurchases of at least $375 million per quarter for the balance of 2024, consistent with January guidance; Q2 repurchases of $500 million exceeded planned run rate

analyst_concerns_not_in_prepared: Trajectory and timing of technology services ACV recovery toward mid-teens target given current 10% growth rate
Specific fundraising strategies and product pipeline for GIP infrastructure platform post-close, including private wealth channel expansion
Whether re-risking is actually occurring out of cash or is merely rotation within other asset classes
